## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Savona, Italy. It starts at Piazzale Dario, Via P. G. Maineri.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Wander the ancient caves of Toirano with a guide and enter a rugged otherworldly realm. Toirano Caves are home the largest cave bear graveyard in Europe but don't fear an unexpected encounter, the last cave bears in Europe died out about 24,000 years ago.
>
> These caves also serve a practical modern-day function. There are over 12,000 bottles of Durin Spumante wine stored down here for fermentation, as the constant temperature of 16°, 90% humidity, and darkness make for the perfect wine cellar!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €18.80. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 158 ratings and 88 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
